item.title: Meta Acquires AI Coding Startup Conductor to Bolster Agentic Coding
item.description:
Meta has confirmed its acquisition of Conductor, a 2024-founded AI coding startup whose tool orchestrates AI agents across multiple parallel, isolated workspaces. The founder will join Meta Superintelligence Labs, while Conductor's cloud service shuts down on November 20 and core features continue until early next year. The deal marks another step in Meta's push to catch up in agentic coding.

原文标题：Meta 收购 AI 编程初创公司 Conductor，加码智能体编程

Why it matters：大厂收购智能体编程初创公司，反映 AI 编程赛道竞争格局变化，但交易细节与产品参数未披露。

item.title: Uber Says Only Four Rides Were Booked by AI Agents in Halloween Week
item.description:
Uber disclosed on its Q3 earnings call that only four rides were booked via AI agents during its highest-volume week in October (Halloween week), versus roughly 500 Uber Eats orders placed by agents out of about 320 million total trips and orders. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi called traction very limited but remains optimistic about net-new demand, noting that all major AI assistant companies are in talks with Uber. DoorDash reported similarly marginal agent-driven order volumes.

原文标题：Uber 财报披露：万圣节周仅 4 笔订单由 AI 智能体叫车

Why it matters：这是迄今最直白的上市公司数据，量化了 AI 智能体在真实交易场景中的采用率之低，为智能体热潮提供了难得的冷思考参照。

item.title: OpenAI Acquires Pierre to Expand Codex Code Review Capabilities
item.description:
OpenAI announced the acquisition of Pierre, folding its Code Storage distributed storage system, Trees file navigation, Diffs change comparison and Highlights real-time highlighting into Codex. Pierre's open-source projects will remain open source and existing customers can keep using Code Storage, as OpenAI aims to build a first-party code writing, understanding and review chain spanning from agent-created branches to deployment.

原文标题：OpenAI 收购 Pierre 扩充 Codex 代码审查能力

Why it matters：这是 OpenAI 围绕 Codex 补齐代码审查工具链的收购动作，方向明确但缺少交易金额与整合时间表。

item.title: OpenAI Says Enterprise Clients Drive Most Revenue, Eyes 2027 IPO Readiness
item.description:
OpenAI president Greg Brockman said at the WSJ Tech conference that most of the company's revenue now comes from enterprise customers, and that he believes OpenAI will be IPO-ready in 2027. The remarks signal a harder enterprise sales push, with Codex agents pitched against rival Anthropic, which is expected to list by year-end; no revenue figures or detailed listing timeline were disclosed.

Why it matters：OpenAI 首次明确营收结构以企业客户为主并给出 2027 年上市口径，是观察其商业模式与资本路径的关键信号。

The move puts Toyota alongside Hyundai and BYD in the automotive robotics race, though no products, specifications or timelines were disclosed.

item.title: Counterpoint: Global DRAM Revenue Nears $200B in Q3, Up 369% YoY
item.description:
Counterpoint reports global DRAM revenue reached nearly $200B in Q3 2026, up 369% year over year, while unit shipments rose only about 4% sequentially, meaning growth was almost entirely price-driven. AI has turned memory from a commodity into a scarce resource; HBM4 competition and a GPU-to-CPU ratio trending toward 1:1 are reshaping vendor standings, and supply tightness is expected to persist as new fabs won't come online until 2028.

原文标题：Counterpoint：三季度全球 DRAM 营收近 2000 亿美元 同比增 369%

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力需求向内存侧传导的关键数据点，直接关系到芯片供应链与成本判断。

item.title: Discord Drops Electron for Rust Rewrite, Cutting Client Memory to 290MB
item.description:
Discord has confirmed it is abandoning Electron and rewriting its desktop client in Rust, with the UI layer built on GPUI, the GPU-accelerated native UI framework from the Zed team, removing the bundled Chromium entirely. A screenshot with two accounts logged in shows roughly 290MB of memory use versus 1–2GB idle (up to 4GB) for the old Electron build. Mobile apps will also migrate from React Native to Rust while keeping native UI and sharing code with desktop; a user-facing beta is coming \\

原文标题：Discord 弃用 Electron，改用 Rust 重写客户端，内存占用降至 290MB

Why it matters：这是大型消费级应用告别 Electron、转向 Rust 原生渲染的标志性架构换血，对关心客户端性能与跨平台技术选型的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: User Jailbreaks NordicTrack Treadmill With Claude Code to Bypass iFIT Paywall
item.description:
A Reddit user used the AI coding tool Claude Code to modify a NordicTrack Commercial 2250 treadmill in roughly a day and a half, bypassing the mandatory iFIT subscription and replacing the locked-down 10-inch display with a custom home screen running Netflix and Crunchyroll. Netflix launch time reportedly dropped from nearly a minute to about 21 seconds, though playback is capped at SD, a factory reset erases the changes, and the modification carries safety and warranty risks. The value lies less in the anecdote itself than in what it shows about coding agents handling real-world hardware reverse engineering.

原文标题：用户借助 Claude Code 越狱跑步机 绕过 iFIT 订阅墙

Why it matters：单个用户的硬件改造案例，分量有限，但它直观呈现了编码智能体在真实设备逆向与系统改造上的落地能力，对关注 AI 编程工具边界的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Kimi Launches Hosted Agents Service Offering Cloud-Managed Agent Runtime
item.description:
Kimi launched Hosted Agents, delivering the agent runtime Harness as a cloud service so enterprises can get a 24/7 managed environment for long-horizon tasks and multi-agent collaboration without building their own framework. It bundles isolated sandboxes, network access control, auditable logs and usage reports, plus 140+ Skills and 30+ plugins, priced at ¥0.072 per sandbox hour plus inference and plugin fees. The move signals agent infrastructure shifting from self-built frameworks to metered, vendor-managed cloud services.

原文标题：Kimi 推出托管智能体服务 按小时计费提供云端运行框架

Why it matters：这是 Agent 基础设施托管化与按量计费的重要产品动作，含明确定价与安全机制，对开发者选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Merges 30,000 Code Changes a Day by Reviewing AI Evidence
item.description:
Anthropic's Addy Osmani says the company went from roughly 2,500 merged code changes a day in May to over 30,000 by September. The workflow has Claude exercise features end-to-end like a real user, auto-fix what breaks, and hand humans runtime evidence such as browser recordings and screenshots instead of line-by-line diffs. He argues coding is no longer the bottleneck and that solid verification, giving AI a way to check its own work, can improve output quality two to three times over.

原文标题：Anthropic 每天合并 3 万次代码变更，人只看 AI 提交的证据

Why it matters：来自 Anthropic 的一手工程实践与量化数据，为“AI 写码后如何敢合并”提供了可复用的验证范式。

item.title: OpenAI Hires Ex-Uber President Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
item.description:
OpenAI said on Nov 3 that Jill Hazelbaker, formerly president and chief corporate affairs officer at Uber, will join as its own chief corporate affairs officer, leading global communications and corporate positioning. She previously ran communications and public policy at Snap and held senior roles at Google, after starting her career in US politics as national communications director for John McCain's 2008 presidential campaign. President Greg Brockman framed the hire around winning public trust as AI reaches more people, describing her as the leader OpenAI needs for its next phase.

原文标题：OpenAI 任命原 Uber 总裁 Jill Hazelbaker 为首席企业事务官

Why it matters：这是 OpenAI 首次设立并向政界与传播出身的资深高管交权的高层人事动作，反映其在监管与公众信任压力下的组织重心转移。

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-Image-2.6 With Native GIF and SVG Output
item.description:
OpenAI has rolled out GPT-Image-2.6 across ChatGPT, Codex and its API for all free and paid users, cutting generation time by roughly 50% with images in as little as six seconds. The substantive change is decoupling scene planning from pixel rendering into separate complexity and quality parameters, so small edits no longer force a full re-layout; the model also natively outputs GIF animations and SVG vector files, with API variants Flare (speed and layout) and Sunburst (high-detail consistency) split by workload.

原文标题：OpenAI 上线 GPT-Image-2.6 原生支持 GIF 与 SVG 导出

Why it matters：这是图像生成模型在控制接口层面的一次实质改动，把“构思”与“渲染”解耦可直接改变开发者的调用成本结构。

item.title: Global Silicon Wafer Shipments Rise 13.4% Year-on-Year in Q3 2026, SEMI Says
item.description:
Global silicon wafer shipments reached 3.756 billion square inches in Q3 2026 — roughly 33.21 million 300mm-equivalent wafers — up 13.4% year-on-year and 5.1% quarter-on-quarter, according to SEMI's Silicon Manufacturers Group. SEMI attributes the growth to AI demand spreading from advanced logic and memory into power devices and photonics, alongside recovering demand from robotics, AI server power supplies and general industrial semiconductors. The figures indicate that AI compute buildout is feeding through to wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging.

原文标题：SEMI：2026Q3 全球硅晶圆出货量同比增长 13.4%

Why it matters：这是观察 AI 算力需求如何传导至半导体上游的关键季度指标，数据来自官方统计，且具有可验证性。

item.title: NVIDIA App Tests GPU Priority Setting Allowing 95% Front-App Allocation
item.description:
Some users have spotted a GPU App Prioritization toggle in NVIDIA App 11.0.9.585 under System → Advanced, offering 80:20 default, 90:10 front-app-priority and a custom 95:5 split between foreground and background GPU workloads. NVIDIA has not documented the feature or its scheduling mechanism, no independent benchmark confirms any frame-rate or inference-throughput gain, and the option appears to be a limited gray-scale rollout that is not visible even on identical app versions.

item.title: 美国 AI 扩张遭遇地方阻力：水电资源和环境争议升温，76% 选民反对在社区建设数据中心
item.description:

item.title: 美国大行封堵外部 AI 智能体 中小银行推出智能体专用账户
item.description:
美国银行业在 AI 智能体接入上出现明显分化：摩根大通、花旗、美国银行、摩根士丹利与富国银行等大行封堵或限制外部智能体，而中小银行则反向推出为智能体设计的账户体系。Cross River Bank 披露三个月内经智能体完成的卡支付超过 4000 万美元、逾 20 万笔，航空为最大支出类别；Lead Bank 允许智能体拥有独立账号并通过 ACH 与电汇转账，但受客户设定限额约束并可即时锁定。

Why it matters：这条消息显示智能体正从软件层进入真实资金流，大行与中小银行的分歧揭示了智能体支付的关键基础设施与风控博弈，并附有可验证的交易规模数据。

item.title: Isomorphic Labs 洽谈 50 亿美元融资 估值约 500 亿美元
item.description:
据 Bloomberg 报道，从 Google DeepMind 分拆出来的 Alphabet 旗下公司 Isomorphic Labs 正洽谈约 50 亿美元融资，估值约 500 亿美元，而目前尚无任何候选药物进入人体试验。其核心资产是基于 AlphaFold 3 的药物设计引擎：它先用计算预测蛋白折叠方式和候选分子与靶点的结合情况，再对分子排序，从而在花钱做合成和动物实验之前淘汰弱设计。但缺少人体数据意味着 500 亿美元估值主要建立在预测精度与药企合作之上，而非分子在患者身上确实有效的证据。

Why it matters：这是 AI 制药领域估值最高的一笔融资动向之一，也直接暴露了“预测能力”与“临床验证”之间的估值鸿沟。

item.title: DeepSeek 工程师称将持续开放模型权重以加速 AGI
item.description:
在世界互联网大会上，DeepSeek 工程师高希表示，即便会带来更高的安全风险，公司仍将继续发布模型权重，以把 AGI 的到来时间从十年压缩到一年、再从一年压缩到“明天”。这属于一次战略方向表态，除“继续开源权重”外没有给出模型参数、发布时间或安全措施等可验证细节，因此实质信息增量有限。

Why it matters：这是头部开放权重实验室对“开源与安全”取舍的公开表态，具备话题价值，但缺少可验证细节，适合快速了解其立场。

item.title: 高盛改口：数据中心所在州政治风险或影响 45% 美国扩建计划
item.description:
高盛在一个月内推翻此前判断，改称民主党掌控五个主要数据中心州可能影响约 45% 的美国在建扩建计划；同一时间，Anthropic 修订后的 IPO 文件首次披露约 8954 亿美元算力与基础设施承诺，其中约 4510 亿美元为已签约但尚未开工的租赁，意味着建设冻结将直接卡住已锁定的产能。叠加高盛与 Visible Alpha 的测算，超大规模厂商资本开支将从 2025 年约 4600 亿美元升至 2030 年约 1.75 万亿美元。

Why it matters：一条推文打包了三项相互印证的算力基建信号，其中 Anthropic 首次披露的千亿美元级承诺与未开工租赁规模，是判断 AI 产能落地节奏的关键变量。

item.title: 中国科大开源 RNA 基础模型 structRFM，成果登上 Nature
item.description:
中国科学技术大学 MIRACLE 实验室发布开源 RNA 序列基础模型 structRFM，相关成果于 11 月 5 日登上《自然》。该模型基于约 2100 万条经计算注释的序列-二级结构配对数据做结构引导预训练，仅输入序列即可输出序列级、核苷酸级与核苷酸对级特征，在二级、三级结构预测及剪接位点、IRES 识别、非编码 RNA 分类等下游任务上达到国际前沿水平，并已开放数据、权重与源代码。这是把“结构知识注入序列预训练”移植到生物大分子领域的一次完整开源交付，对 AI for Science 读者具有直接复用价值。

Why it matters：这是一次完整的开源交付，包含数据、权重与代码，且方法有新意；它把结构引导预训练带入 RNA 领域，并由《自然》论文与消融实验背书。
